evidence.reason: The current build still omits `commit_id` whenever `hunkMap` is null. The body-only retry passes `hunks=null`, so if the PR head advances before that retry, GitHub will attach the review to the newer head rather than the reviewed head described by the body. That breaks exact-head review binding; `commit_id` should be set independently of inline-hunk availability, and a rejected reviewed commit should surface as a failure.
